name: Chico Chico
description: Brazilian singer Chico Chico presents the album Let it Burn - Deixa Arder at M.Ou.Co. in Porto.
longDescription:
Brazilian singer Chico Chico performs at M.Ou.Co. - JAM Porto on 1 December 2026. The concert features material from the album Let it Burn - Deixa Arder.

The performance begins at 21:00 at Rua de Frei Heitor Pinto, 65. Tickets cost 32€.
